name: Chandra Talpade Mohanty
shortBio: Indian-born postcolonial and transnational feminist theorist whose critique of Western feminist universalism transformed comparative sociology, intersectionality, and anti-capitalist global solidarity.
centralQuestion: How does Western feminist scholarship homogenize diverse "Third World women" into a monolithic victim category, and how can transnational solidarity avoid discursive colonization?

keyWorks.title: Under Western Eyes: Feminist Scholarship and Colonial Discourses
keyWorks.description: Seminal critique exposing Eurocentric power-knowledge biases in Western feminist analyses of Global South women.

keyWorks.title: Feminism Without Borders: Decolonizing Theory, Practicing Solidarity
keyWorks.description: Develops transnational feminist praxis linking anti-racist, decolonial, and anti-capitalist methodology across borders.
